theorem restoreSubtracted (span coordinate : Nat) (inside : coordinate ≤ span) :
    span - coordinate + coordinate = span

theorem addManySpans (coordinate span copies : Nat) :

proofs.name: ArtPlanetarium.accepted_parameters_iff

    (∃ validated, validateMaterialParameters raw = some validated) ↔
      ParameterRequirements raw

proofs.name: ArtPlanetarium.tile_coordinate_remains_inside_span

proofs.name: ArtPlanetarium.mirror_twice_recovers_coordinate
proofs.sourceSignature:
theorem mirror_twice_recovers_coordinate (span coordinate : Nat) (inside : coordinate ≤ span) :
    mirrorCoordinate span (mirrorCoordinate span coordinate) = coordinate

proofs.name: ArtPlanetarium.mirrored_pair_preserves_span
proofs.sourceSignature:
theorem mirrored_pair_preserves_span (span coordinate : Nat) (inside : coordinate ≤ span) :
    coordinate + mirrorCoordinate span coordinate = span

proofs.name: ArtPlanetarium.grid_coordinates_are_aligned

theorem grid_coordinates_are_aligned (step index : Nat) :
    gridCoordinate step index % step = 0

proofs.name: ArtPlanetarium.grid_coordinates_preserve_strict_order
proofs.sourceSignature:
theorem grid_coordinates_preserve_strict_order (step first second : Nat)
    (positive : 0 < step) (ordered : first < second) :
    gridCoordinate step first < gridCoordinate step second

theorem route_angles_are_eighth_turns (index : Nat) :

proofs.name: ArtPlanetarium.stale_evidence_cannot_pass
proofs.sourceSignature:
theorem stale_evidence_cannot_pass (supports contradicts : Nat) :
    reviewEvidence supports contradicts true = .staleEvidence

proofs.name: ArtPlanetarium.contradiction_cannot_pass
proofs.sourceSignature:
theorem contradiction_cannot_pass (supports contradictions : Nat) :
    reviewEvidence supports (contradictions + 1) false = .fail

proofs.name: ArtPlanetarium.neutral_only_evidence_cannot_pass

proofs.name: ArtPlanetarium.evidence_pass_requires_support_without_contradiction
proofs.sourceSignature:
theorem evidence_pass_requires_support_without_contradiction (supports contradicts : Nat) (stale : Bool) :
    reviewEvidence supports contradicts stale = .pass ↔
      0 < supports ∧ contradicts = 0 ∧ stale = false
